heading: Wednesday, July 8, 2026
topLine: 3 model releases: Mistral AI Robostral Navigate, xAI Grok 4.5 and OpenAI GPT-Live.

items.headline: Mistral introduces Robostral Navigate for robot navigation
items.summary: Robostral Navigate is Mistral's first embodied navigation model, an 8B-parameter model that guides wheeled, legged or flying robots from a single RGB camera and plain-language instructions. Mistral reports a 76.6% success rate on the R2R-CE unseen validation split, ahead of prior single-camera approaches.

items.headline: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5, trained with Cursor
items.summary: Grok 4.5, from the rebranded xAI (SpaceXAI), is a model for coding, agentic tasks and office work trained alongside Cursor; it is the default model in Grok Build and available in Cursor and the API at $2/$6 per million input/output tokens. The company reports it leads on SWE Marathon but trails top rivals on several other coding evaluations.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces GPT-Live voice models for ChatGPT
items.summary: GPT-Live is a full-duplex voice model family that can listen and speak at the same time and hands off harder tasks to a frontier model in the background; GPT-Live-1 became the default for paid ChatGPT Voice users and GPT-Live-1 mini for free users. API access followed on September 10.
